title: Adventures
description: Explore the forest on horseback, take flight up to the sky, or grab a kayak and gently float on by.

items.title: Kayaking
items.description: 3 hour return trip to the waterfall and back, totaling around 2 hours paddling and 1 hour hiking.

items.title: Paragliding
items.description: 15 minutes in the air with beautiful views of the ocean and surrounding forests and mountains.

items.title: Horseriding
items.description: 1.5 hour trail through the forests of the Wilderness Heights.

items.title: Half Collared Kingfisher Trail
items.description: 3 hour trail along the Touw River, leading to the waterfall. Great for swimming.

items.title: Brown Hooded Kingfisher Trail
items.description: 2 hour trail crossing multiple times over the Duiwe River.

items.title: Bosduif Trail
items.description: 2 hour loop trail up to breath-taking viewpoints above the Touw River, and back down again.

items.title: Woodville Big Tree
items.description: Visit a 1000 year old Yellow Wood tree and marvel at its size and glory. 3km and 7km trails looping back around.

items.title: Wilderness Beach
items.description: Blue Flag beach perfect for a nice sunny day.

items.title: Water Under the Bridge
items.description: Take a leap into the refreshing Touws River from our railway bridge jumping spot.

items.title: Fairy Labyrinth
items.description: Something on your mind? Unravel and unwind.

items.title: Ancient Archives
items.description: Books, books, books in all the nooks.

cta.title: Adventure Safely
cta.description: Always check the weather. Wear appropriate clothing and footwear. Stay hydrated and carry water. Inform staff of any medical need to knows. Wear a hat on sunny expeditions. Bring a backpack. Carry snacks. Watch out for the big bad wolf.
